horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Analyze the shear across the ferrofluid sea.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Prepare defenses for the upcoming storm.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The rugged coast of the ferrofluid sea stretches under the dusk sky. Jagged metallic rocks reflect the faint light of the twin suns. The viscous sea churns against the shore.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Dark metallic silver and deep orange.
sensory_palette.sound: A low, resonant hum of magnetic shear.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A rusted pillar humming with energy.
A churning pool of metallic liquid.
A sturdy rock formation providing cover.

reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The wave will collapse the coastal shelf.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Kaio must measure the shear to predict the storm.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The Wilds need accurate data to protect the Genesis Garden.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Understanding the ferrofluid sea is key to surviving on this exoplanet.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: Equipment failure leading to severe injury.

graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio gets the data but his scanner breaks.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio discovers a new pattern in the shear.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio finishes adjusting his brass sextant to the humming magnetic waves and turns, holding out the heavy ledger and a handful of glowing pebbles to Ryn.
